defects.title: post_content contains 69 hardcoded installation URLs
defects.evidence: /wp-json/wp/v2/pages/4 on 9400 returns content with http://127.0.0.1:9400/wp-content/themes/...; no {{}} tokens remain. setup.php:raouf_upsert_page() expands tokens BEFORE wp_insert_post. Moving the site to another domain breaks images/links.
defects.fix: Store tokenised markup in post_content and expand tokens at render time (templates already call raouf_expand_tokens()).

defects.title: Duplicate canonical tag on 10 of 11 routes
defects.evidence: theme header.php emits <link rel="canonical" href="/courses/">; WordPress core rel_canonical emits a second absolute one. Verified on 3000 vs 9400.

defects.title: Duplicate robots meta tag on 10 of 11 routes
defects.evidence: original <meta name="robots" content="index, follow"> plus WP core wp_robots <meta name='robots' content='max-image-preview:large' />.

defects.title: source-code.zip is stale
defects.evidence: 111 entries, no docs/ files, missing make-pdfs.mjs, dom-compare.py, upload-test.mjs; PDFs are newer than this ZIP.
defects.fix: Rebuild after documentation and QA scripts are final.

defects.title: Submission message body not visible to administrator
defects.evidence: options.php:raouf_submissions_page() lists ref/kind/name/phone/course/date only; post_content (the actual message) and email are not shown; CPT has show_ui=false so no detail screen.
defects.fix: Add a detail column/view for message + email in the submissions admin page.

defects.title: inc/icons.php lacks direct-access guard
defects.evidence: 27 of 28 PHP files contain defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit; inc/icons.php does not.

defects.title: CJK typo in generated report/PDF generator
defects.evidence: qa/make-pdfs.mjs: «لینت مجدد全部 فایلها»; docs/conversion-report.md: «تکمیل所有 تصاویر»; PDF embeds the first one.

defects.title: POT incomplete
defects.evidence: 33 translatable calls in PHP, only 28 msgids in languages/raouf-academy.pot.
defects.fix: Regenerate POT from all PHP files.

defects.title: Stale code comments / converter artifacts
defects.evidence: helpers.php references non-existent inc/media.php; front-page.php docblock «Template for //».

defects.title: Only 6 of 67 images are Media-Library replaceable
defects.evidence: options.php:raouf_replaceable_images() lists 6 paths. Requirement allowed 'where practical'; document as limitation.

defects.title: Internal hrefs are absolute WP URLs instead of original relative paths
defects.evidence: All prior DOM comparisons normalised this away; visually identical, but attribute values differ from source (home_url() output).
defects.fix: Intentional WP API adaptation; document as an accepted deviation (no visual change).

defects.title: style.css font URLs rewritten from absolute to relative
defects.evidence: Only 4 diff ops vs original CSS: WP header, leading newline, and 3 /assets/fonts/ → assets/fonts/ rewrites; needed because the stylesheet moved to theme root.
